data.headline: AREC acquires Wyoming County assets, not its mining permits

claims.text: AREC acquired certain real property, structures, fixtures and equipment from Wyoming County Coal in Wyoming County, West Virginia on September 29, 2026.

citation.quote: On September 29, 2026, American Resources Corporation (the “Company” or “ARC”) entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement (the “Asset Purchase Agreement”) with Wyoming County Coal LLC (“WCC”), pursuant to which the Company acquired certain real property, structures, fixtures and equipment owned by WCC located in Wyoming County, West Virginia

claims.text: The consideration was settlement of litigation for an aggregate settlement amount of $40.0 million.

citation.quote: Pursuant to the Asset Purchase Agreement, the consideration for the Acquired Assets consists of the Company's settlement of certain litigation pending in the United States District Court for the Southern District of Indiana, captioned UMB Bank, N.A. v. Wyoming County Coal LLC, et al., Case No. 1:25-cv-02596, for an aggregate settlement amount of $40.0 million

claims.text: The acquired property includes rights to valuable elements and minerals contained within refuse piles.

citation.quote: The acquired real property also includes rights and ownership with respect to valuable elements and minerals that may be contained within refuse piles located on or within the conveyed property.

claims.text: AREC is not acquiring or assuming WCC's mining permits or licenses or its historical mining, reclamation, environmental or other operating liabilities.

citation.quote: The Company is not acquiring or assuming WCC's mining permits or licenses and is not assuming WCC's historical mining, reclamation, environmental or other operating liabilities, including asset retirement obligations (“AROs”) associated with WCC's prior mining operations.

claims.text: WCC's mining permits were in various stages of planning, with no mines currently in production.

citation.quote: The mining permits held by Wyoming County Coal are in various stages of planning with no mines currently in production.
